subject: Makegood request — lapsed promo credits for EdgeCloud pilot

Subject: Request: expired promo credits for Pilot #EC-TRIAL

Hi Vanessa —

Quick one: our pilot credits (promo code applied at sign-up) rolled off two days ago and our sandbox runs have blocked. We were mid-load-testing and had a POC demo with internal stakeholders scheduled for 31 Mar; losing access will stall that.

Can Redwood make a one-time exception to reissue the promotional credit or extend the expiry by 30 days? We used roughly 60% of the promo during initial evaluation and will need another ~200k tokens to complete the demo and the integration tests. If helpful, I attached our usage export.

Key context:
- Account: EdgeCloud (Rajiv Menon is the CTO)
- Promo code: REDWOOD-EARLY-2026 (expired 23 Mar 2026)
- Pilot contact: me (Leah)

Would appreciate a quick try — this POC moves to procurement if the demo goes well.

Thanks,
Leah Barton
Product Manager — EdgeCloud

I'm sorry the promo expired mid-test — we try to avoid that. I'll route this to Sales Ops for a one-time makegood and see if we can extend the expiry by 30 days. A couple quick asks so we can move fast:

- Any contractual constraints (PO, procurement date) we should expect if the demo succeeds?

Connor — looping you in to approve and issue the credits if possible.

I'll follow up as soon as I have confirmation.
